name: stackoverflow_qa_neutral
description: Short programming question titles. Goal: the same content or entity must get the same canonical name across questions.
canonicalization_hints: Every question has a primary technology anchor — emit (Question, about_technology, <Canonical_Tech>). Canonicalize names: 'Flask-Login'/'Flask-SQLAlchemy'/'Flask 2.0' all carry the anchor Flask (plus the specific module as its own Technology when named).
Canonicalize: Docker, Kubernetes, Flask, Rust, TensorFlow, Entity_Framework, JDBC, Active_Directory, SQL, DataSet, DataTable, EHCache.
Capture the operation/concept the question is about: performs_operation (Query, Join, Paging, Authentication, Logging, Validation, Type_Conversion) and integrates_with for cross-technology questions.
The asker's framing ('How do I', 'Best way to', 'Beginners guide') is a speech act — drop it. Use a single 'Question' subject node as the anchor.
Extract what the title actually asks.

inline_examples.text: How do I deserialize a JSON response into a struct in Rust?
How do you authenticate against an Active Directory server using Flask-Login?
